hints: Three nested loops, and k must be the OUTERMOST. That order is the entire algorithm - swap it and it compiles, runs and gives wrong answers.
Convert 999 to a large INF when reading, and skip the update when either d[i][k] or d[k][j] is INF so you never add to infinity.
After the loops, a negative number on the diagonal means some vertex can reach itself with negative total cost - a negative cycle.
